hopelessness.line: There is the hope and the hopelessness
stanza: In the church they light the candles
And the wax rolls down like tears
There is the hope and the hopelessness

hopelessness.line: And to everything, there is no meaning, a season of pain and hopelessness
stanza: And to everything, there is no meaning, a season of pain and hopelessness
I shouldn't have looked for revelation, I should have resigned myself to this
I thought I could change the world around me, I thought I could change the worl…
I thought I was called in convocation, I thought I was sanctified and blessed
